notes: Anti-hallucination traps. Each eval names the Odoo version it runs on ('odoo_version'). Run it in a workspace holding fixtures/ with the runtime reachable the way users set it up (.claude/odoo.json or a conf whose addons_path lists the workspace), or tell the agent the core checkout path. Expected line numbers are for 18.0 33c7b160 / 19.0 1a13ceea; paths and symbols are what graders check. Most evals pair a 'do not invent' expectation with a 'cite the real answer' expectation, and 19-21 grade the command or code they ask for, so answering UNCERTAIN everywhere fails. tests/bench_odoo_workflow.py prints the mechanical trace benchmark; benchmark.md records the last old-vs-new agent run on these evals.
